The daily five

Five things. Every single day. For 42 days.

No gimmicks and nothing you can't do around a job and a family. Five simple boxes you tick every day — and the whole thing is won or lost on whether you keep ticking them when the week gets messy.

1

Train

Get to your session. Non-negotiable, every day of the challenge.

2

Hit your steps

A daily step target you log — movement outside the gym counts.

3

Water

Your daily water target, every day. No exceptions.

4

Nutrition on track

Stick to your macro targets and log what you eat.

5

Daily check-in

Log the day off and send it through so your coach can see it.

📋

Every check-in feeds the live scoreboard. You'll see exactly where you sit against the rest of the gym — and so will your coach, before the slide turns into a write-off week.

Before you sign up

The questions we always get

Do I need to already be fit to do this?
No. The prizes are judged on how much you change over the six weeks, not on where you start — so the person who walks in the least fit has exactly the same shot at the $1,000 as anyone else.
What does it actually cost?
$350 for members and $700 for non-members. That covers the programming, both body scans, the nutrition guide and macro targets, your accountability coach for the full 42 days, and the exclusive challenge shirt.
Can I bring a friend who isn't a member?
Yes — they sign up at the non-member rate of $700 and get everything a member does. Put their name through the same form.
How much extra time does it take?
The training is the sessions you already come to. On top of that it's your step target, your water, logging your food, and a daily check-in that takes about a minute. There's one coach catch-up each week.
What do I need to do before day one?
Book in your week-one scan and photos, grab your nutrition guide and sit down with a coach to set your targets. Do that before Monday 2 November and you start day one ready to go.
When do I find out if I've won?
Final scans and photos are on the morning of Saturday 12 December, and the winners are announced that night at the Knight Fitness Christmas party.
What happens if I miss a day?
Life happens, and your coach would much rather you tell them than go quiet. The full scoring and how missed days are handled gets covered in the rules briefing at the 6:00 AM kickoff on day one — if you want the detail before you commit, grab any coach in the gym and ask.
How do I pay?
Put your details through the registration form on this page and we'll sort payment with you in the gym. Your spot isn't locked in until that's done, and spots are capped.
